A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before
your visit.

Can I book through this website?

This is a website concept. The appointment walkthrough lets you explore a future booking experience, but does not reserve a time or contact the salon. For a real appointment, call (281) 477-9044.

How much will my service cost?

Call the salon for current pricing. Color and styling needs vary by hair length, condition, and the result you want. No prices in this demo are presented as salon quotes.

Can I bring a hairstyle photo?

Absolutely. Save an inspiration look or bring a photo to help explain what you have in mind. Your stylist can discuss the options for your own hair.

Do you offer family haircuts?

Hair by Four is a family salon. Public recommendations mention services for adults and children. Call ahead to discuss your family’s needs.

Are these photos the salon’s actual work?

The lookbook uses original AI-generated editorial inspiration images for this proposal. They do not depict Hair by Four customers, staff, or completed salon work.

DEMO PRIVACY

Just a walkthrough.

Appointment selections and fictional contact details stay in this page’s memory. They are not submitted, saved to browser storage, or shared with the salon. Closing the demo clears them.

No analytics, advertising trackers, payment collection, or live booking system is installed. Directions and public recommendation links open external services, whose privacy policies apply.
